html:
Create your app’s API credentials on the Open Platform. You’ll need to include the APPKEY in your requests when calling the API later. The Open Platform uses this ID to calculate metrics such as call volume, success rate, and QPS.

App Categories (Recommended)

Partner Types：Enterprise/Personal Self-Developed

Seller In-house APP

This app provides access to nearly all API calls related to seller stores. If your system needs to integrate modules including, but not limited to, orders, products, finance, fulfillment, and returns, please create this app.

In-house IM Chat

This provides access permissions for IM API/Webhook calls and supports querying product and order information. It is primarily used to enable seller customer service representatives to assist Lazada buyers with inquiries from external systems.

Redmart

The Redmart API can be called; this is intended solely for Redmart sellers in Singapore. Non-Redmart sellers and ISVs should not create this app.

Partner Types：Enterprises Commercial

ERP System

This app provides access to nearly all API calls related to seller stores. If your system needs to integrate modules including, but not limited to, orders, products, finance, fulfillment, and returns, please create this app.

ERP IM Chat

This provides access permissions for IM API/Webhook calls and supports querying product and order information. It is primarily used to enable seller customer service representatives to assist Lazada buyers with inquiries from external systems.

For other apps, please refer to this document to select the service marketplace category you wish to publish in, and then choose the corresponding app category to submit your application.

Create an App

First, go to the “App Management” page and click “Create App” to access the app creation page. Locate “Seller In-house App,” click “Apply,” and enter a reason for your request. We typically review applications on the same day; if that day is a holiday, we will review it on the next business day.

Note: The screenshot is for demonstration purposes only and does not imply a recommendation of the Lazada Logistics category. For seller developers integrating the platform for the first time, we strongly recommend applying for and creating a “Seller In-house APP.”

Once the application is approved, the status of the corresponding app category will be updated to “Active.” At this point, you’ll need to first click on the category, then click “Create App” at the bottom right to access the creation page.

In the “Create App” section, you need to enter the information shown in the screenshot, then click “Confirm” to complete the app creation.

Note:

-- You can edit the Callback URL at any time after it has been created, so feel free to enter any URL that starts with HTTPS for now;

-- The App Logo must be exactly 120×120 px.
